s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute respiratory symptoms with obstructing tracheal mass
salient_findings: Polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Mass causing obstruction of main bronchi
key_facts: 48-year-old white man
Lifelong non-smoker
Remote bronchoscopic resection of tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier
Three-month history of mild hemoptysis and cough
Non-tender subcutaneous mass on left forearm
Normal vital signs
Oxygen saturation of 94% on room air
Normal complete blood count, liver and renal function tests, and coagulation profile
Chest CT scan showed polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Flexible bronchoscopy revealed mass arising from anterior tracheal wall
Mass caused 80% obstruction of right main bronchus and 70% obstruction of left main bronchus

shortlist.label: Tracheal carcinoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of tracheal carcinoid tumor resection and current presentation is similar

shortlist.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Common tracheal tumor type that can cause obstructive symptoms

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Common cause of tracheal tumors, especially in adults

shortlist.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Type of tracheal tumor that can cause obstructive symptoms and has been reported in similar cases

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Rare but possible cause of tracheal obstruction, especially in the context of a subcutaneous mass

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of remote bronchoscopic resection of a tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier and the current tumor's histological description of large nests of eosinophilic cells within a collagenous and myxoid matrix is consistent with a carcinoid tumor.

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: No specific histological features mentioned that are typical of adenoid cystic carcinoma

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The histological description does not match the typical appearance of squamous cell carcinoma

rejected.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
rejected.why: No mention of mucin production or epidermoid cells that are characteristic of mucoepidermoid carcinoma

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and histological description do not align with the typical features of inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
